\begin{lexlean}{Studio.Gui.Instance}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\importmodule{Studio.Runtime}
\importmodule{Studio.Instance}
\title{Natural number addition}
\begin{semanticmodule}
definition{
  name: journey,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bytes,
  body: 0x6a6f75726e657920696e7374616e6365733a205365652077686572652074686520696e7374616e636573206f6620796f757220507269736d2049442072756e2c20616e64206b656570207468656d2073796e6368726f6e697a656420756e6465722069740a
}

definition{
  name: syncEnabled,
  parameters: [owner : Bool, hosted : Bool],
  result: Bool,
  body: (owner && hosted),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: action,
  parameters: [enabled : Bool],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if enabled then 0x616374696f6e2073796e633a20656e61626c6564 else 0x616374696f6e2073796e633a2064697361626c6564),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: present,
  parameters: [viewer : Bytes, prismId : Bytes, hosts : (List Bytes)],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (journey) (prim append (if (Studio.Instance::runtimeHost hosts) then (prim append 0x7669657720696e7374616e636573486f737465643a20 (Studio.Instance::hostHandOff prismId) : Bytes) else (prim append 0x7669657720696e7374616e6365734d6972726f724f6e6c793a20 (Studio.Instance::hostRefusal prismId) : Bytes)) (prim append 0x0a (action (syncEnabled (Studio.Runtime::same viewer prismId) (Studio.Instance::runtimeHost hosts))) : Bytes) : Bytes) : Bytes),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: request,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::split value 9)
    | List.cons verb f1 => (match f1
      | List.cons viewer f2 => (match f2
        | List.cons prismId hosts => (if (Studio.Runtime::same verb 0x76696577) then (present viewer prismId hosts) else 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
        | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
      | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
    | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: only_the_owner_synchronizes,
  parameters: [hosted : Bool],
  statement: ((syncEnabled false hosted) = false),
  proof: reflexivity{},
  axioms: []
}

theorem{
  name: the_owner_sees_its_hosted_instances,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request 0x7669657709707269736d3a616c657809707269736d3a616c6578096769746875620962726f777365720970686f6e65) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: another_prism_id_cannot_synchronize,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request 0x7669657709707269736d3a626f6209707269736d3a616c6578096769746875620962726f777365720970686f6e65) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: shows_instances_on_the_mirror_alone,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request 0x7669657709707269736d3a616c657809707269736d3a616c657809676974687562) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
\end{semanticmodule}
\end{lexlean}
